#Bitcoin : #dogecoin 

I think @elonmusk should not tweet about #crypto. He is doing more harm to an average trader.

#Bitcoin : $SHIB development team's claim about #dogecoin killer is also a mistake, I think. 

Can't we live together? Why grow at a cost of killing another project? 

$SHIB has the advantage of top exchanges listing at an early stage and they should focus on the development.

@elonmusk @lexfridman @VitalikButerin @ethereum @Bitcoin @dogecoin @ShibainuCoin @IOHK_Charles @Cardano @chainlink @0xPolygon On which front? Care to elaborate given lot of topics were discussed in a podcast. Thanks.
$SHIB: Do we really need to know ... $DOGE made many millionaires in the recent past (e.g., @RookieXBT ) and I think $SHIB is going to do the same ...
